title:
Transform for tabs in the All Assets Page title.

- Determines if the Geospatial Assets Map tab should be displayed.

This transform accepts a JSON object with the following properties:
tabs {UiSdlPageTab[]} - Array of tabs to be displayed in the App Configuration page title.
isAssetsMapEnabled {Boolean} - Feature flag for Geospatial Assets Map.
name: AssetsPageTitleTabsTransform
